messages:
sasha: Late-night confession time — whats a weird ice cream flavor you secretly love? :icecream:
oliver: burnt caramel sea salt. Some people think its just burnt sugar but its peak mood food.
katie: black sesame. always. tells people its tahini but its ice cream and theyre suspicious. :face_with_monocle:
dan: jalapef1o mango sorbet. spicy then sweet, dont @ me.
maria: ugh i tried miso caramel once and now im ruined for regular caramel. savory umami vibes.
sasha: oh wow miso caramel sounds wild. 
oliver: also vote for lavender honey. suspect until you try it on toast too.
katie: quick poll — two choices: black sesame or lavender honey? react with :one: or :two:
oliver: :one: (black sesame)
maria: :two: (lavender honey)
dan: :one: but only if its dense and not airy gelato style
sasha: @oliver do you have a shop rec?
oliver: tiny place in the Mission, "Moonlit Scoops" — they do a roasted sesame swirl thats dangerously addictive.
sasha: adding to weekend itinerary.
giphy-bot: [gif: tiny spoon dramatically entering ice cream bowl]
katie: also pro-secret-flavor rule: you cant order it on a first date unless youre both fearless.
maria: true. thats a compatibility test. :heartpulse:
dan: noting for my future dating algorithm.
sasha: OK thanks team, next watercooler: weird pizza toppings youd defend.
